name: Link
summary: Navigates to a URL or route. Not for performing an action on this page (use Button).
a11y: Native `a[href]`; underlined so it is never colour alone (`link.decoration`; a theme that turns the rest line off keeps it on hover and keyboard focus, and owes 3:1 between link and text colour); `aria-current="page"` when current.

props.name: href
props.description: Where it goes: a URL or an in-app route. Inside the core router (`@design-library/core/site`), a route (`/talks`) or an anchor (`#speakers`) is written for its mode and handled by it.

props.name: children
props.description: Link text that says where it goes; never "click here".

props.name: current
props.description: Marks the link to the page the person is on.

props.name: external
props.description: Goes to another site: shows the external icon with a spoken twin. Opens in the same tab.

props.name: newTab
props.description: Opens in a new browser tab (`target="_blank"`, `rel="noopener"`): shows the new-tab icon with a spoken twin. For something the person keeps beside this page, like a standalone preview.

props.name: onPointerEnter
props.description: The pointer arrives over it (IP9), e.g. to preview the place it goes.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: It takes focus (IP9): pair with `onPointerEnter` so a keyboard reaches the same preview.

settings.description: A link's line at rest: underline (default) or none. With none, the link colour must stand 3:1 from the text around it; the line still shows on hover and keyboard focus.
A link's line on hover and keyboard focus: underline (default). Keep it when the rest line is off: it is the cue that isn't colour.
